title: TR-EIF TR-EIP Model Manifest
description: Structural schema for a concrete TR-EIP model manifest inside the TR-EIF framework. The manifest identifies result-affecting model architecture, parameter artifact, admissible species, units, E(3) symmetry, graph rule, representation structure, resonance structure, balanced-ternary structure, output capabilities, numerical semantics, and provenance. Runtime state is not part of the model manifest.

model_family.description: Concrete interatomic model family inside TR-EIF. TR-EIP is not the TR-EIF framework itself.

architecture_id.description: Identifier of the result-affecting model architecture, separate from parameter values.

parameter_artifact.description: Versioned parameter artifact when the concrete model has learned, calibrated, or otherwise externalized parameters. JSON null explicitly declares that no separate parameter artifact is used.

unit_system_id.description: Explicit identifier of the model unit convention. No unit system is inferred by this schema.

symmetry_group.description: TR-EIP operates under the declared E(3)-equivariant interatomic contract.

message_depth.description: Declared number of message-passing stages in the concrete model realization.

cutoff.description: Declared graph cutoff in the manifest unit convention.

higher_order_channels.description: May be zero for an executable realization that implements only scalar and polar-vector channels. Formal higher-order support in documentation does not imply executable higher-order channels.

state_domain.description: Resonance state remains continuous and is not identified with balanced-ternary execution state.

active_neutral_state.description: State 0 is active neutral: balancing, routing, damping, mediation, transition staging, retention, and controlled neutralization.

direct_opposite_committed_transitions.description: Committed -1 -> 1 and 1 -> -1 transitions are forbidden. Opposite-polarity execution proceeds through separate events via active neutral state 0.

differentiation_id.description: Explicit identifier of the force/stress differentiation path used by the concrete realization.

$comment: The model manifest defines a concrete TR-EIP model realization; runtime configuration, resonance state, ternary execution state, pending targets, and observables are separate artifacts. TR-EIP is a model family inside TR-EIF: TR-EIP subset TR-EIF. Resonance remains continuous. Balanced ternary execution remains -1/0/1 with active neutral state 0. Validation status, missing data, unknown values, NaN, errors, and abstention are not encoded through ternary 0. Manifest-schema validity alone does not establish determinism; reproducibility additionally requires that execution consume only declared result-affecting state and configuration.
